top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a quantitative continuum-model prediction of flat bands at a magic twist angle (Bistritzer-MacDonald) and the experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states in exactly that regime (Jarillo-Herrero), with one tunable parameter controlling bandwidth against interaction. The core observation is reproduced by independent groups and carried to other moire platforms, and a citation limited to the prediction and the observed states survives either outcome on the pairing mechanism. The three-name allocation is the one most members converged on, though Yuan Cao and earlier twisted-bilayer theorists remain outside it. P002 (optical lattice clocks, Katori and Ye) is the mature, cleanly attributed fallback, but it is a refinement of an established metrology area; no award ranks last because two proposals are scientifically sound.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero, Bistritzer, Katori or Ye
